Getting Started

Get up and running with Karibase CSS Framework

Introduction

Karibase is a progressive CSS framework for building efficient, scalable dashboards and admin panels. It provides a comprehensive set of pre-built components, utilities, and design tokens to help you create beautiful interfaces quickly.

Whether you're building a simple admin panel or a complex SaaS dashboard, Karibase has everything you need to get started quickly and scale your project efficiently.

Quick Start

Get started with Karibase in just a few simple steps:

1. Include Karibase CSS

Add the Karibase CSS file to your HTML:

html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/karibase@2.0.0/css/karibase.css">

2. Create Your First Component

Start using Karibase components:

html
<div class="kb-card">
  <div class="kb-card-header">
    <h3 class="kb-card-title">Welcome to Karibase</h3>
  </div>
  <div class="kb-card-body">
    <p class="kb-text">This is your first Karibase component!</p>
  </div>
</div>

3. Customize with CSS Variables

Personalize your design with CSS variables:

html
:root {
  --kb-primary: #ea2845;
  --kb-secondary: #6366f1;
  --kb-radius: 12px;
}

Installation

Install Karibase using your preferred package manager:

npm

html
npm install karibase

yarn

html
yarn add karibase

pnpm

html
pnpm add karibase

CDN

Use Karibase directly from CDN without any build tools:

html
<!-- CSS -->
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/karibase@2.0.0/css/karibase.css">

<!-- JavaScript (optional) -->
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/karibase@2.0.0/js/karibase.js"></script>

Project Structure

Karibase follows a modular structure:

html
karibase/
├── css/
│   ├── karibase.css          # Main entry point
│   ├── karibase-variables.css    # Design tokens
│   ├── karibase-reset.css        # CSS reset
│   ├── karibase-base.css         # Base styles
│   ├── karibase-components.css   # UI components
│   ├── karibase-utilities.css    # Utility classes
│   └── karibase-dark-mode.css    # Dark theme
├── js/
│   └── karibase.js          # Optional JavaScript
└── scss/
    ├── karibase.scss        # Source files
    └── components/          # Component SCSS

Build Tools

Karibase works with popular build tools:

Vite

html
import 'karibase/css/karibase.css'

Webpack

html
import 'karibase/css/karibase.css'

Parcel

html
@import 'karibase/css/karibase.css';

What's Included

Karibase comes with everything you need:

  • Design System: Complete set of CSS variables for colors, spacing, typography, and more
  • Components: Pre-built UI components including buttons, cards, forms, tables, and more
  • Layout: Grid system, containers, and layout utilities
  • Utilities: Extensive utility classes for rapid development
  • Dark Mode: Built-in dark theme support
  • Responsive: Mobile-first responsive design
  • Accessibility: WCAG AA compliant components

Browser Support

Karibase supports all modern browsers:

  • Chrome (latest)
  • Firefox (latest)
  • Safari (latest)
  • Edge (latest)
  • Opera (latest)

For older browsers, you may need to add appropriate polyfills.
